comment: Russian pronoun tables for OstraI18n. Index order: [I, you, he, she, they, it] = PronounInflection [First, Second, ThirdMasculine, ThirdFeminine, ThirdNeuter, ThirdNeuterNonHuman]. contract* categories collapse to plain subject pronouns (Russian has no contractions; copula/auxiliary handled by verbs pack). pos v1 = masculine-singular base forms (его/её/их are invariant); full case/gender agreement = v2.
